    • Terminally Deprecated Elements
      Element
      Description
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.ScrollContainer.OPTIONS_INSET_X
      Renamed ScrollContainer.DEFAULT_INSET_X in 7.3.0 (the Default look); removed in 8.0.0.
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.ScrollContainer.OPTIONS_INSET_Y
      Renamed ScrollContainer.DEFAULT_INSET_Y in 7.3.0 (the Default look); removed in 8.0.0.
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.host.OwnHost.add(Panel, PanelPosition, int)
      Replaced in 7.4.0 by OwnHost.add(Panel, int), which reads where the panel goes in each mode from its placements; removed in 8.0.0. This is position in both modes, whatever placements the panel declares.
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.hud.HudCycleStrip.slideDone(long)
      see HudCycleStrip.slideProgress(long); use HudCycleStrip.begin() and HudCycleStrip.slideDone(SlideStart) instead.
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.hud.HudCycleStrip.slideProgress(long)
      startMillis must be Util.getMillis(); a value from another clock (vanilla's System.currentTimeMillis(), for one) silently never reports done, since the two clocks measure from a different zero. Use HudCycleStrip.begin() and HudCycleStrip.slideProgress(SlideStart) instead, which cannot take the wrong clock. Kept through MenuKit 7.x; removed in 8.0.0.
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.hud.HudPanel.builder(String)
      Replaced in 7.4.0 by HudPanel.builder(String, ModeScope), which picks the mode scope; removed in 8.0.0. builder(name, ModeScope.BOTH) is this call.
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.AnchorPanelAdapter.on(Anchor...)
      Replaced in 7.4.0 by Placement.around(Anchor, PanelPosition), the anchor in the placement; removed in 8.0.0. in(ModeScope.BOTH, Placement.around(anchor, position)) on the panel is position(position) with this call, and needs no on.
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.Panel.Builder.position(PanelPosition)
      Replaced in 7.4.0 by Panel.Builder.in(ModeScope, Placement), which picks the mode scope; removed in 8.0.0. in(ModeScope.BOTH, Placement.screen(position)) is this call.
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.ScreenKind.CONTAINER
      Renamed ScreenKind.PANEL in 7.3.0; removed in 8.0.0.
      com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.ScreenKind.OPTIONS
      Renamed ScreenKind.DEFAULT in 7.3.0; removed in 8.0.0.
